vlm_integration_scope: DetectionPipeline computes and records the learned (or default) VLM routing decision on every validated image scan (ScanResult.forensicVlmRoute). The VLM deep scan runs only when OnDemandForensicVlmAnalyzer.experimentalVlmCascadeEnabled is true, an imported policy bundle with a head_contract exists at <filesDir>/vlm_packs/forensic_vlm_policy.json, and a VlmPrefillBackend is registered. No native VLM runtime (llama.cpp mtmd / LiteRT-LM) ships in this revision, so on a stock build the deep scan never executes, and its outcome never replaces the calibrated specialist verdict.
evidence_status_note: The unit-test and --self-test outputs verify mathematical invariants, contract enforcement, Python/Kotlin head-projection parity (untrained random-weight fixture), source-level deduplication, masked loss handling, lease exclusivity, and routing mechanics on synthetic test inputs. Actual Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B detection metrics (TPR @ 1% FPR, TPR @ 5% FPR, conditional and total early-exit miss rates) require executing the Colab T4 training-and-export pilot on held-out forensic splits.
